title: Superman Returns Prequel #1 #2 Lot DC 2006 Krypton to Earth Ma Kent Bryan Singer
conditionDescription: Both bright and clean with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
Lot of 2: Superman Returns Prequel #1 and #2 of 4 (August 2006), DC Comics - prequel to the Superman Returns film. Story by Bryan Singer, Michael Dougherty and Dan Harris.

- #1 Krypton to Earth: script by Jimmy Palmiotti and Justin Gray, art by Ariel Olivetti.
- #2 Ma Kent: script by Marc Andreyko, art and cover by Karl Kerschl.

Direct sales, $3.99 cover price each. Back covers: both Disney/Pixar Cars videogame ads.

Condition: both bright and clean with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
